title: HLTV 5-player match-lineup disambiguation of duplicate-named Valve standings rows and unranked low-tier CS2 fixtures

valve_snapshot.core_rule: Valve Regional Standings assign a team row to a 5-player roster core (>= 3 of 5 players). When two rows in standings_global_2026_10_05.md share the same team name (an active roster and an older core), comparing the official HLTV match page's 5-player lineup against each candidate row's 5-player roster uniquely selects a row only when exactly one candidate has >= 3/5 shared players.

fixtures.name_only_failure: Just Players appears twice in standings_global_2026_10_05.md (#118 with 974 pts and #347 with 485 pts); name-only lookup refuses to guess between duplicate team names.
fixtures.rationale: HLTV match 2399087 publishes both 5-player lineups. BET-M matches Valve #71 (1149 pts) on 4/5 core players (bluewh1te, executor, Raijin, z1Nny; Patsi in for synyx). Just Players matches Valve #118 (974 pts) on 4/5 core players (h1te, sm3t, sstiNiX, Temny Prince; wh1teout in for bl1x1), whereas duplicate row #347 (485 pts) shares only 1/5 players (sstiNiX) and is rejected under the >= 3/5 Valve core rule. Replaying Valve's Glicko expectation (RD=75) yields BET-M 72.71% / Just Players 27.29%.
limitations: No Polymarket, Kalshi, Thunderpick, or Bovada money line exists for CCT Season 3 Europe Series 9 fixture 1079170.
Both teams made one fifth-man change relative to the 2026-10-05 Valve snapshot (Patsi for synyx on BET-M; wh1teout for bl1x1 on Just Players), while preserving 4/5 of their Valve-rated core.

The automated name-only pipeline (data/origination.json) keeps this row blank because it does not read HLTV match-page lineups; this disambiguated probability is published with full player-level audit evidence.
